title: Blast mainnet launches with protocol-native yield
description: Blast mainnet introduced protocol-native yield for bridged ETH and stablecoin balances as part of the L2's core design.
notes: Launch event establishes the yield mechanism's historical start on mainnet.

title: Blast announces network wind-down and native-yield unwind
description: Blast announced an orderly L2 wind-down, directed users to withdraw to Ethereum, and said withdrawals would be temporarily unavailable while Blast's Lido assets were withdrawn before the exit process resumed with a 24-hour delay.
notes: The announcement is a wind-down transition, not evidence of insolvency or a completed customer-loss event. Blast said normal interface withdrawals would remain available through October 26 and direct L1 bridge-contract withdrawals afterward.
